purpose: Keep paper-native evidence, compute-budget comparability, and untouched-OOS evidence separate. Unknown fields remain unknown rather than being inferred.

families.paper_native_evidence: Paper reports alpha-decay resistance across Chinese CSI 500 and US S&P 500 settings over multiple market regimes.
families.paper_native_metric: paper-specific alpha/predictive/portfolio metrics; not normalized here

families.paper_native_evidence: ICLR 2026 paper reports OOS test-period performance, valid/pass rates and generalization on AlphaEvo500/Alpha158, including small 1.7B-4B models.
Paper demonstrates that executable-factor evaluation removes action-emission instability and enables deterministic/reproducible comparison across LLMs.
families.paper_native_metric: benchmark reproducibility and executable strategy quality

families.paper_native_evidence: Paper reports gains against eight baselines on three Chinese equity datasets in predictive accuracy, return stability and training efficiency.
Paper reports strong predictive and portfolio performance in the Chinese stock market and comparable implementation quality across different LLMs for the same schema plans.
Paper reports superior predictive accuracy, robustness and generalization on A-share equities relative to existing methods.
Paper reports diverse high-quality factor libraries with low redundancy across multiple datasets, assets and markets.
Paper reports CSI 300 results and cross-market transfer to CSI 500 and S&P 500; headline values include IC/ARR/MDD and multi-year cumulative excess return.
Paper reports real-market backtests, up to 2x annualized return versus classical factor libraries with 70% fewer factors, plus gains over deep time-series models.
External WorldQuant BRAIN deployments report 60 submissions / 17 SPECTACULAR, best Fitness 9.50 and Sharpe 3.48; all submissions entered platform OS tracking.
families.paper_native_metric: WorldQuant BRAIN platform-assigned Fitness/Sharpe and SPECTACULAR status
families.compute_budget_comparability: PARTIAL: normal 16-to-1 halving pipeline nominally uses 31 evaluator calls before retries; full deployment compute is not normalized to investor2

cross_family_gaps: No family currently has a completed investor2 matched head-to-head under a common fixed evaluator-call budget.
Exact evaluator-call/token/wall-clock budgets are not consistently extractable from the current canonical notes; paper result magnitude must not be used to fill this gap.
Paper-reported OOS, cross-market transfer, benchmark reproducibility and external-platform acceptance are different evidence classes and must remain separate.
The common experiment must freeze untouched-OOS before adaptive search begins and count every candidate/evaluator call, including rejected and duplicate candidates.
